# Repository status

Audit date: 2026-11-12.

Historical material selected for reversible archival in the 2026-11-12 audit.

Historical student coursework. Preserve all 61 branches and their authorship; default-branch similarity does not justify deleting student branches.

Archival, when applied in GitHub settings, makes the repository read-only; it does not delete files or history. The GitHub archive badge is the authoritative current state. Reopen the repository before accepting new work.

## File policy

Keep research data, source figures, notebooks, manuscripts, licensing and citation information. Ignore only generated local caches/environments and machine-specific configuration. Existing tracked files are not removed by ignore rules. Do not rename this repository or rewrite history as part of housekeeping.
